description: NaNdHf₂O₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Nd is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. All Nd-O bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Hf is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Hf-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Nd, and two equivalent Hf atoms.
